messages:
Hannah: Quick synthesis from today's cross-team DR run. Success overall but surfaced a few systemic follow-ups we should track centrally: (A) routing convergence visibility + gating, (B) canonical backup selection + sandbox restore automation, (C) deploy-time config drift detection. Dropping proposed owners/dates.

Raj: Routing notes: saw a 18s tail on a subset of prefixes due to BGP path churn combined with our immediate traffic-swap. We need a converge histogram and a short quiesce window before swapping weights. Propose metric name: routing.converge_ms; gate: require p95 < 4s for 30s.

Kei: Restore notes: we accidentally used a shared SA in the sandbox during the test. I'll build a sandboxed one-click restore job that uses ephemeral SA keys and writes a verification artifact to s3://dr-verifications/. Also will add checksum verification step.

Marta: Config drift: one regional Envoy pool was missing the healthcheck label after a fast canary. CI schema treats it as optional. I'll make the label required and add a deploy-time sanity check to fail fast.

ops-bot: dr-run-2026-06-20: summary logged; follow-ups created INF-600, INF-601, INF-602.

Hannah: Action list (please ack and confirm dates):
1) Routing converge metric + gating
- Owner: Raj
- Due: 2026-07-01
- Ticket: INF-600
- Notes: add metric, dashboard, and modify traffic-swap script to wait for gating rule.

2) One-click sandbox restore + ephemeral creds
- Owner: Kei
- Due: 2026-06-27
- Ticket: INF-601
- Notes: Jenkins job that restores into an isolated project/namespace, runs app-level smoke tests, uploads verification artifact. Snippet below.

3) Envoy label enforcement + deploy guard
- Owner: Marta
- Due: 2026-06-25
- Ticket: INF-602
- Notes: schema change + deploy-step check; add regression that simulates weight bind.

Sandbox restore example snippet to include in runbook (place under "sandbox-restore"):

```
# create ephemeral creds
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create /tmp/key.json --iam-account=dr-sandbox@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
export GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS=/tmp/key.json
# restore into sandbox cluster with verify
rdb restore --from s3://redwood-backups/prod/latest --to cluster=dr-sandbox --namespace=dr-test-$(date +%s) --verify
# run app smoke test (isolated)
kubectl --context dr-sandbox -n dr-test-$(date +%s) run smoke --image=redwood/smoke:stable -- /bin/sh -c "curl -fsS http://app/health || exit 1"
# upload verification
echo "restore-id: restore-$(date +%s)" > /tmp/restore-meta.txt
aws s3 cp /tmp/restore-meta.txt s3://dr-verifications/restore-$(date +%s).txt
```

Hannah: Also noting recurring pattern: label/schema drift after rapid canaries (3x in last 90d) and two runs used shared creds. Those are systemic and must be addressed by the tickets above.

Raj: ack. I'll add Grafana panels and an alert: fire if route converge p95 > 10s for 5m. Will attach dashboard JSON to INF-600.

Kei: ack. I'll prototype the Jenkins job today, add a dry-run flag, and ensure it never runs with prod credentials. Linking INF-601.

Marta: ack. I'll open PR to tighten schema and add deploy guard; will include small e2e regression to exercise label binding. Linking INF-602.

Hannah: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem ticket with owners/dates and schedule a short validation sync in two weeks. Closing thread; tickets will hold details. If anything else pops up, drop it here and ops-bot will append to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
